description: Folds eight signals standing for the corners of a cube down to one stereo pair for headphones, each corner given the arrival time and tone colour of its own fixed direction

params.text: Sets the level of both outputs, 0% to 100%

inputs.text: The corner ahead, to the left and above; it reaches the left ear first and is treated as near
The corner ahead, to the right and above; it reaches the right ear first and is treated as near
The corner behind, to the left and above; it is treated as four times as far away as the front corners, so duller and wetter
The corner behind, to the right and above; it is treated as four times as far away as the front corners, so duller and wetter
The corner ahead, to the left and below; it reaches the left ear first and is treated as near
The corner ahead, to the right and below; it reaches the right ear first and is treated as near
The corner behind, to the left and below; it is treated as four times as far away as the front corners, so duller and wetter
The corner behind, to the right and below; it is treated as four times as far away as the front corners, so duller and wetter

outputs.text: The left ear: all eight inputs delayed, filtered and mixed for a listener facing the front pair
The right ear: all eight inputs delayed, filtered and mixed for a listener facing the front pair

notes: nothing here can be aimed. The eight directions are fixed in the code at 45 and 135 degrees left and right, 30 degrees above and below, and cannot be moved from the panel or by CV.
an unpatched input is skipped outright rather than mixed as silence, so the module costs nothing for corners you are not using.
